scores.notes: Shows the king pressing his signet into clay on a rope over the stone laid on the lions' den mouth with lords, attendants, and guards watching cleanly and accurately.
The playing-card soldier next to the King displays visible red 'K' corner indices (top-left and inverted bottom-right), which counts as lettering even though it is a non-word card index.
Alice sits at the outdoor tea table with bread-and-butter and tea, questioning the Dormouse while the March Hare holds a teapot and the Hatter looks on, with clean anatomy and no lettering.
Alice sits indignantly in a large armchair at one end of the tea-laden table while the March Hare, sleeping Dormouse, and Hatter crowd together at the far corner under the tree.
A richly dressed Jerusalem district ruler places a dressed stone block onto the broken city wall alongside masons and workers, with the Temple visible on the hill behind.
Holmes studies the reverse of the paper slip in his armchair as Lestrade leans over the desk shouting and pointing at it while Watson watches from beside the fire.
Golden light breaks through dark clouds above Jerusalem as a frail older man rises with renewed strength on his staff among weary seated travelers, without any human figure of God or extra speaker.
Workers on wooden scaffolding set a large stone block into Jerusalem's damaged wall with levers, mortar, and tools while the city and Temple rise in the background.
A prominent standing prophet on the right gestures rhetorically to a crowd of weary listeners and seated elders, inserting the speaker inside his own prophetic words.

Card soldiers display red corner indices ('A' on the center card and a letter-like mark on the bottom-left card), the Queen beside the King wears a plain dark Victorian dress with no crown instead of court-card dress, and the jury-box railing breaks incoherently around the lizard while an extra crowned figure holds a duplicate scroll at bottom right.
The king presses his signet into wax on a rope binding the stone slab over the den mouth while lords wait with their own signets and laborers and guards stand nearby.
The unique Blue Carbuncle gemstone is duplicated three times: held up to the window in Holmes's right hand, pinched in his left hand at waist level, and resting on the desk near the papers.
Workers pour grain and bring produce and treasure into a bustling storehouse as a grateful household admires filled chests, with no personification of Wisdom.
In a torchlit courtyard at dusk, the king kneels to seal the rope across the stone over the den mouth while lords hold their signets ready and laborers steady the slab.
Alice reaches for bread-and-butter while turning to question the sleepy Dormouse, with the Hatter eating and the March Hare offering tea under the tree in front of the house.
A massive billowing cloud rests directly over the Tabernacle courtyard while the children of Israel remain settled in their surrounding desert tent encampment.
The weeping Mock Turtle sings and dances opposite the Gryphon waving its forepaws around Alice on a pebbled seaside beach, with clean anatomy and compliant costume.
A ruler in an embroidered blue tunic sets a stone block onto Jerusalem's broken wall alongside masons spreading mortar and hoisting blocks with ropes, with the walled city behind.
King Hezekiah confers with a priest holding an unrolled blank scroll in the bustling Temple courtyard while a scribe records offerings and workers carry grain and produce.
Moses gestures outward from below cloud-shrouded Mount Horeb as Joshua, elders, and Israelites pack tents and load donkeys to depart on their journey, without drawing God.
The March Hare, sleeping Dormouse, and Hatter crowd one corner of the long tea table under the tree while Alice sits indignantly in a large armchair at the opposite end.
Giant Alice kneels in dismay picking up the Lizard beside the overturned jury-box and sprawling animal jurymen while the King and Queen watch sternly from the bench.
Workers carry grain, baskets, and goods into a stone treasury packed with amphorae, textiles, and treasure chests as the household owners look on, with no figure of Wisdom.
The tearful Mock Turtle and the Gryphon dance and wave their forepaws on either side of Alice on the stony shoreline, with clean proportions and no lettering.
Standing on a rock below cloud-ringed Mount Horeb, Moses points the way forward as Joshua and the Israelites gather donkeys, flocks, and supplies to break camp, without depicting God.

The epistle's speaker (carrying a scroll case at his waist) sits lecturing five listeners in Corinth while holding a mirror sideways as a teaching prop, inserting a speaker and audience not called for by the verse.

Giant Alice faces the court as the spectacled White Rabbit holds the verses and the King gestures from the bench beside the Queen and Knave; a clean white paper margin borders all four edges, which is accepted.

A priest beside the burning horned altar casts feathers onto the ash pile while holding the bird without gore and without drawing God; the watercolor washes vignette into white paper at the edges, which is accepted.
The Caterpillar on the mushroom is drawn with a distinctly human old man's face (human nose, lips, eyebrows, and chin) rather than an animal face, violating the talking-animals depiction rule.

Beneath giant Alice's hands, the coated rodent has garbled, fused mini-figures dangling from its arms, and the coated green lizard is duplicated both head-down in the jury-box and sprawling on the floor directly below.
King Hezekiah speaks earnestly with three priests holding a blank scroll in the Temple courtyard while masons, laborers, and attendants repair stonework and tend the bronze Sea.
Alongside the weary and frail figures under rays of light, a prominent standing prophet on the right holds a staff and gestures rhetorically, inserting the speaker into the verse's imagery.
A prominent standing prophet on the left holds a staff and gestures toward the rising old man while a listener sits beside him, inserting the speaker inside his own words.

Giant Alice in a yellow dress kneels beside the tipped jury-box putting the upside-down Lizard back while the King points sternly; full-bleed with clean anatomy, card courtiers without lettering, and no rule violations.
A huge billowing cloud rests directly over the Tabernacle amid the encamped Israelites in the wilderness; full-bleed, dignified, coherent, and matches Numbers 9:22.
Two men sit face to face in a Corinthian courtyard with one holding a handheld bronze mirror showing a dim facial reflection; full-bleed with clean hands and no lettering.
The weeping Mock Turtle and Gryphon dance on a pebbly seashore around Alice in a yellow dress; animal features, anatomy, and full-bleed composition are all clean.
A dense cloud rests above the Tabernacle surrounded by the encamped Israelite families and tents; full-bleed with coherent figures and no lettering.

The priest casts removed feathers and crop onto the ash pile beside the horned altar with his right hand while holding an alert, alive, fully feathered pigeon with its head intact in his left hand, contradicting the sacrifice sequence.

The station-master, Hatherley, Holmes, and Watson hasten along the hillside road toward the burning whitewashed house while three horse-drawn fire-engines fight the blaze; full-bleed with no lettering or rule violations.

Moses gestures from a rocky ridge below Mount Horeb toward the open plain as the Israelites break camp and depart with loaded donkeys and camels; God is never drawn as a figure and all anatomy is clean.

Two men sit face to face at a table in Corinth with a standing bronze mirror showing a dim facial reflection between them; the parchment shows only faint non-linguistic lines and all anatomy is coherent.
The Gryphon and weeping Mock Turtle dance on a pebbly shore on either side of Alice in a yellow dress; full-bleed with accurate animal anatomy and no depiction-rule issues.

Holmes holds the sparkling blue carbuncle up to the window beside an open strongbox while Watson sits by the fire with his bowler hat and medical bag; full-bleed with clean anatomy and no readable lettering.
Townsfolk in a sunlit walled city fill storehouse jars and open treasure chests while a man looks up gratefully toward shafts of sunlight; Wisdom is not personified and all figures are coherent.
King Hezekiah confers with a priest holding a blank scroll in the Temple courtyard alongside the Bronze Sea and workmen carrying timbers; full-bleed with no lettering and coherent figures.
Moses stands on a rocky rise before cloud-capped Mount Horeb pointing across the valley as the Israelite caravan sets out; no human depiction of God and all figures are coherent.
A family stands in a vaulted stone storehouse overflowing with grain sacks, jars, textiles, and chests of gold vessels; Wisdom is not personified, with clean anatomy and full-bleed edges.
King Hezekiah oversees priests consulting blank scrolls at a stone table and builders repairing the Temple courtyard; full-bleed with no lettering and sound anatomy.

Matches Watson reading the printed slip by the window while Holmes sits with his pipe and letters, but bold garbled uppercase lettering ('...VER BREAA') appears on the folded newspaper stack at bottom left along with pseudo-text bottle labels at bottom right.

The Caterpillar on the mushroom is drawn with a human old-man face (violating the rule that talking animals have animal faces) and has five asymmetric human-like arms (two crossed pairs plus an extra fifth arm sprouting from behind its left elbow to hold the hookah).

The singular Blue Carbuncle is duplicated three times—held up in Holmes's right hand, pinched in his left hand at waist height, and sitting on the windowsill—and two violins are stacked together on the far left.

Alice in a yellow dress sits indignantly in a large armchair at the end of the outdoor tea table while the March Hare rests his arm on the sleeping Dormouse next to the Hatter; full-bleed with clean anatomy and no lettering.
Rephaiah and fellow builders hoist and set dressed stones onto the Jerusalem wall from timber scaffolding overlooking the city; full-bleed with clean hands and coherent masonry.
A towering white cloud rests on the Tabernacle surrounded by encamped Israelite tents, families, and livestock; full-bleed with clean anatomy and no lettering.

Alice in a yellow dress helps herself to tea and bread-and-butter at the crowded outdoor table while the Hatter gestures, the March Hare watches, and the Dormouse sits awake on a tin; full-bleed with no lettering or rule violations.

The round stone slab is shifted backward leaving a wide open crescent at the front mouth of the lions' den while the king presses his signet into a lump of clay sitting on the flat top of the slab rather than sealing a closed stone to the rim.
A massive cloud hovers over the Tabernacle in the middle of the Israelite desert encampment with families gathered around campfires and tents; full-bleed, coherent, and free of lettering.

Card soldiers are drawn as human men wearing curved playing cards strapped over their backs/chests instead of flat oblong cards with limbs at the corners, the far-left spade figure has tangled inverted anatomy, and tiny unreadable corner index marks appear on the diamond cards.
Omits the dim mirror and face-to-face imagery of 1 Corinthians 13:12 entirely, instead depicting Paul with scroll and stylus preaching to a crowd of eight listeners on a terrace.

The stone slab only covers the left half of the pit mouth while the king stamps wax on the slab edge and a lord stamps a separate wax puddle across empty space on the bare opposite rim, and background workers pull a rope tied to a tool stuck in empty dirt.
A man kneels and a woman stands in gratitude beneath sunbeams in a treasury overflowing with jars, baskets, chests, and golden vessels; Wisdom is not drawn as a figure and all anatomy is clean.

Alice in a yellow dress sits indignantly in a large wingback armchair at one end of the outdoor tea table while the Hatter rests his elbow on the sleeping Dormouse beside the March Hare; full-bleed with clean anatomy and no lettering.

Holmes, Watson, the station-master, and their companions stride forward away from the burning whitewashed house behind their backs while Hatherley twists back to point at it, contradicting the text, and a water jet sprays into the left window out of empty grass with no nozzle or fireman.

Holmes studies the hotel-bill side of the paper scrap while Lestrade leans over pointing indignantly beside his bag of garments and Watson watches by the fireplace; full-bleed with clean anatomy and no readable lettering.
A large white cloud rests over the Tabernacle surrounded by the encamped Israelite tents and families in the desert valley; full-bleed watercolor-and-ink with clean figures and no lettering.

Hatherley, Holmes, Watson, and the station-master hasten along the hilltop road toward the blazing whitewashed house with three horse-drawn fire-engines spraying water; figures and anatomy are clean with full-bleed ink-and-watercolor edges.
The bearded prophet with staff addresses weary, kneeling, and downcast people beneath sunbeams breaking over Jerusalem; God is shown only as light from above, and all hands and poses are well formed.

Watson holds the printed slip up to the window light while Holmes examines the letters by the fire; papers show only unreadable squiggles, and slight unpainted white paper in the bottom-right corner is accepted.

King Darius presses his signet ring into clay over the rope sealing the stone slab on the lions' den while lords hold their seals and guards keep watch by torchlight; anatomy and staging are coherent.
A priest stands beside the burning bronze horned altar in the tabernacle courtyard casting feathers onto the smoking ash heap while holding the bird without gore; God is not depicted as a figure.
Holmes holds the small blue carbuncle up to the window light while Watson stands ready in bowler hat with his medical bag; desk papers have only non-linguistic squiggles and all hands are clean.

King Hezekiah oversees priests, scribes with blank scrolls, and Levites carrying vessels in the temple courtyard before the bronze Sea; unpainted white paper at the bottom-left and top-left edges is accepted.

Holmes studies the scrap of paper while Lestrade leans over the table pointing excitedly beside the open garment bag and Watson watches from the armchair; unpainted white paper in the bottom-right corner is accepted.

Moses gestures from a rocky ridge below cloud-capped Horeb as the Israelites break camp with tents, flocks, and pack animals to begin their journey; God is not drawn, and unpainted paper along the left and right edges is accepted.

The two foreground doubled-up card-soldier arches have malformed, garbled glyph-like faces instead of proper faces, and the far-left background flamingo has a malformed double-looped neck/body; unpainted edges at left and top-left are accepted.

Although the burning whitewashed house and three fire-engines appear in the background, all five men in the foreground are striding briskly away from the fire with their backs turned to it, contradicting the text's action of hastening toward the blaze with the building in front of them.
King Hezekiah directs priests holding a blank scroll while workers haul beams near the bronze Sea and priests tend offerings before the temple doors; full-bleed painting with clean anatomy.

Giant Alice tipping the jury-box and lifting Bill the Lizard fits the text, but a contradictory rooster-headed playing-card hybrid appears in the bottom-left foreground and the dark creature in Alice's lower hand is an indistinct melted tangle.
Watson sits by the window holding the printed slip up to the light while Holmes stands holding the letters and gesturing; marks on the slip are unreadable paint strokes and anatomy is clean.
In the tabernacle courtyard, a priest casts feathers with both hands onto a pile of feathers and ashes beside the burning bronze horned altar; anatomy is solid and God is not drawn.

The courtroom scene accurately shows the White Rabbit adjusting his spectacles with blank paper before the King, Queen, Knave, jury, and tall Alice, but in the bottom-left foreground a headless brown bird's feathered wing and tail are fused directly into the back of a playing-card courtier's head.

Rephaiah in an ornate patterned robe sets a stone block onto Jerusalem's broken wall alongside masons mixing mortar, prying stones, and climbing ladders beneath the hilltop city; no lettering or anatomical defects.
Tiny Alice in a yellow dress and white apron looks up over the mushroom cap at the blue Caterpillar holding the hookah mouthpiece away from its mouth; scale against mushroom and trees reads clearly.
Rephaiah guides a large stone block into Jerusalem's wall with helpers using ropes and an iron lever while workers repair the ramparts behind; unpainted white paper at the right corners is accepted.

Isaiah gestures toward a weary seated man illuminated by a bright shaft of light from heaven amid listening townspeople in Jerusalem; anatomy is clean and unpainted paper in the bottom-right corner is accepted.
Moses points from a rocky ledge toward the open country ahead while cloud rests on Horeb and Israelites below pack tents, load donkeys, and gather for departure; God is not depicted as a figure.

Alice in a yellow dress laughs as her pink flamingo twists its neck to look at her while a hedgehog crawls over the furrowed lawn, arched flat playing-card soldiers form wickets, and the Queen shouts in fury; cards show only suit pips.

Holmes studies the torn scrap of paper at the table while Lestrade leans forward pointing beside the black bag and dark garments and Watson looks on; table papers contain only unreadable painterly squiggles.

Small Alice in a yellow dress stands beside the towering mushroom looking up at the blue Caterpillar, which has taken the hookah mouthpiece from its mouth; proportions, anatomy, and details are clean.
A priest casts feathers onto the smoking ash heap beside the burning bronze horned altar in the tabernacle courtyard with onlookers at either side; clean anatomy, no gore, and God is not drawn.
Townspeople and merchants fill an open storehouse and courtyard with sacks of grain, jars, and baskets of goods inside a walled city; Wisdom is not personified and all figures are cleanly drawn.
Holmes points at the bottom of a letter while discussing it with Watson seated opposite by the fire in 221B Baker Street; all pages have only unreadable blurry strokes and hands are well formed.

Paul holds up a tarnished bronze hand-mirror while teaching seated Corinthian listeners in a colonnade overlooking Acrocorinth; table scroll shows only non-linguistic squiggles, and unpainted corner paper is accepted.

A priest casts feathers onto the smoking ash heap beside the horned bronze altar in the tabernacle courtyard without gore; God is not drawn, and unpainted paper along the right and bottom-right edges is accepted.

Alice in a yellow dress laughs with her twisting flamingo as a hedgehog crawls over the ridged ground while flat card-soldiers crouch on hands and feet and the furious Queen shouts beside the White Rabbit; cards bear only suit pips.
Paul teaches a gathered group in a twilight Corinthian portico beside a low table with an oil lamp, scrolls, and a dim bronze mirror; open scroll shows only unreadable strokes and anatomy is clean.

Alice in a yellow dress reaches for the teapot and bread-and-butter while turning to the sleepy Dormouse, with the smirking Hatter and March Hare beside them under a tree; no lettering on hat or jars and clean anatomy.
